about: How each ability-art asset is lifted out of its editable source under design/abilities/source/. A layer is exported alone in its own box, with the patterns it uses. Built by design/tools/abilities-assets.mjs into design/abilities/assets/. A proposal outside the reviewed manifest design-0.2.0, adopted only through Integration.

bundle.name: abilities
bundle.audience: private art: drawn only inside a seat's own open private sheet
bundle.loadPolicy: Every player phone, once, with the player bundles (public-board, player-ui, roles), before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. The table display does not load it. Which requests a phone makes says nothing about its role.

neutral.about: Paper, ink and steel only: no team accent, no room color, no crew color, so no piece of the kit can be told apart by role, team or character.

rights: Original vector artwork made for this repository by the Visual and Motion Designer (Claude Code session) for Mothership. No third-party artwork, font, photograph or generated raster image is used. The portraits drawn into a file are the approved crew cards (design/source/crew/, design-0.2.0), referenced, not copied.

assets.title: Cork of a private file
assets.use: Tiled behind a private file (background-repeat), at 96 CSS px or smaller.

assets.title: A strip of tape
assets.use: Across a file's top corners, turned 35 to 45 degrees.

assets.title: A push pin
assets.use: Holds every snapshot and the envelope; one drawing for every candidate.

assets.title: A snapshot frame
assets.use: Around a player's chosen crew card: the portrait fills the window. One frame for every candidate alike.

assets.title: A query tag
assets.use: On the corner of every candidate's snapshot alike: this one is not known.

assets.title: A magnifying lens
assets.use: Marks what can be inspected; never a result.

assets.title: A paper clip
assets.use: Holds a slip to an envelope.

assets.title: A rubber-stamp frame
assets.use: Around a live word stamped on a file (CLASSIFIED, ONE EACH). The word is live text, never drawn.

assets.title: An open envelope, behind what it holds
assets.use: Behind a slip that stands in it; the front layer goes over the slip.

assets.title: An open envelope, in front of what it holds
assets.use: Over the lower part of a slip that stands in the envelope.

assets.title: A closed folder
assets.use: The cover of any private file while it is hidden: the same for every role.
